desc: Sangamon class carrier hit off Samar 1944.jpeg U.S. Navy escort carriers pictured at sea during the Battle of Leyte Gulf. A Curtiss SB2C-3 Helldiver of Bombing Squadron 7 (VB-7) is visible in the upper right of the photograph.
